T1.attack_vector: An attacker intercepts unencrypted BLE communication to capture authentication tokens.

T2.attack_vector: An adversary reuses a captured e-key credential to gain unauthorized access as the legitimate user.

T3.attack_vector: An attacker exploits the insecure OTA update mechanism to deliver malicious firmware, enabling unauthorized control of the door lock.

T4.attack_vector: Exploitation of STRIDE-I-001 (Information Disclosure via Cleartext Credential Transmission) via unencrypted transmission targeting Cryptographic Keys

T5.attack_vector: Exploitation of ATT&CK-T1557 (Adversary-in-the-Middle) via unencrypted transmission targeting User PII (schedule, address)

T6.attack_vector: An attacker exploits weak authentication mechanisms to gain unauthorized access to cryptographic key material.
